title: PaintersInc
description: A painting mod collab of several artists
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe2c9ac1699a3ce680e5402771a584d09683fa25.png)

**Painter's Inc** is a simple mod adding **25 new Paintings** to the game.
To create this mod we gathered **25 different artists** who each contributed a single Painting in their own unique style.

Below is a list of all painting names and social media links to each artist and if you want to know how the paintings look, please check out the Gallery tab.

We hope you enjoy this project! :D

 ![The Painters](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eed7382f56a6b1c72d8276d74001ad765595e452.png)
